# Chewing Timing Data Loading
```{r}
# Prepare all conditions and paths
base_dir <- "Annotated_Data"
conds <- c("visible_pair", "invisible_pair")
persons <- c("A", "B")

# Create a file list for each condition
file_tbl <- expand_grid(
  condition = conds,
  person = persons
) %>%
  mutate(
    folder = file.path(base_dir, paste0(condition, "_Human"), person),
    files = map(folder, ~list.files(.x, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  unnest(files)

# Obtain the chew point header from the first file (assuming it's common for all files)
header <- names(read_csv(file_tbl$files[1], n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
chew_cols <- header[str_detect(header, "^Chew_")]

time_to_sec <- function(t) {
  if (is.na(t) || t == "") return(NA_real_)
  m <- str_match(t, "^(\\d+):(\\d+\\.\\d+)$")
  if (!is.na(m[1,1])) {
    return(as.numeric(m[1,2]) * 60 + as.numeric(m[1,3]))
  }
  as.numeric(t)  # If it's already seconds, just leave it as is
}

chew_long_human_all <- map2_dfr(
  file_tbl$files, file_tbl$condition, function(f, condition) {
    fname <- basename(f)
    id_match <- str_match(fname, "^(\\d{8}_\\d+_\\d+)_([0-9]+)_([AB])\\.csv$")
    if (is.na(id_match[1,1])) return(tibble())
    id_main <- id_match[1,2]
    session <- as.integer(id_match[1,3])
    person <- id_match[1,4]
    id <- paste0(id_main, "_", person)
    pair_id <- id_main
    
    df <- read_csv(
      f,
      col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), Trial = col_integer()),
      na = c("", "NA"),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
    chew_cols_in_file <- intersect(names(df), chew_cols)
    df_long <- df %>%
      mutate(trial = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(chew_cols_in_file),
        names_to = "chew_num",
        values_to = "time_str"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        chew_num = as.integer(str_extract(chew_num, "\\d+")),
        time_sec = map_dbl(time_str, time_to_sec),
        id = id,
        session = session,
        pair_id = pair_id,
        person = person,
        condition = condition
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(time_sec)) %>%
      dplyr::select(id, session, trial, chew_num, time_sec, pair_id, person, condition)
    df_long
  }
)
chew_long_human_all
```

```{r}
# ==== Basic Parameters ====
bin_width <- 10
n_bin <- 180 / bin_width
window_size <- 6

# ==== 1. Create the chewing count series for each bin, separated by A/B ====
bin_counts_human <- chew_long_human_all %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("visible_pair", "invisible_pair")) %>%
  mutate(
    bin = cut(time_sec, breaks = seq(0, bin_width * n_bin, by = bin_width),
              labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
  group_by(condition, pair_id, session, bin, person) %>%
  summarise(n_chew = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(
    condition, pair_id, session, bin = 1:n_bin, person = c("A", "B"),
    fill = list(n_chew = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person, values_from = n_chew) %>%
  arrange(condition, pair_id, session, bin)

# ==== 2. Calculate the rolling correlation series (Fisher z) for each real_pair ====
rolling_cors_real_human <- bin_counts_human %>%
  group_by(pair_id, session, condition) %>%
  arrange(bin) %>%
  mutate(
    rolling_cor = rollapply(
      data = tibble(A, B),
      width = window_size,
      FUN = function(x) {
        if (any(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
        if (all(rowSums(x) == 0)) return(NA_real_)
        cor(x[,1], x[,2])
      },
      by.column = FALSE,
      align = "right",
      fill = NA_real_
    ),
    bin = as.integer(bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(rolling_zcor = atanh(rolling_cor)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pair_type = "real_pair")

# ==== 3. Create shuffled_pair ====
bin_counts_long_human <- bin_counts_human %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(A, B), names_to = "person", values_to = "n_chew")

shuffled_pairs_human <- bin_counts_long_human %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, session, bin, pair_id, person, n_chew) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person, values_from = n_chew) %>%
  expand_grid(
    .,
    other_pair_id = unique(bin_counts_long_human$pair_id)
  ) %>%
  filter(pair_id != other_pair_id) %>%
  left_join(
    bin_counts_human %>% dplyr::select(condition, session, bin, pair_id, B) %>% rename(B_shuf = B, B_id = pair_id),
    by = c("condition", "session", "bin", "other_pair_id" = "B_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(B_shuf))

rolling_cors_shuf_human <- shuffled_pairs_human %>%
  group_by(condition, session, pair_id, other_pair_id) %>%
  arrange(bin) %>%
  mutate(
    rolling_cor = rollapply(
      data = tibble(A, B_shuf),
      width = window_size,
      FUN = function(x) {
        if (any(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
        if (all(rowSums(x) == 0)) return(NA_real_)
        cor(x[,1], x[,2])
      },
      by.column = FALSE,
      align = "right",
      fill = NA_real_
    ),
    bin = as.integer(bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(rolling_zcor = atanh(rolling_cor)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pair_type = "shuffled_pair")

# ==== 4. Combine real and shuffled (in long format) ====
all_cor_long_human <- bind_rows(
  rolling_cors_real_human %>% dplyr::select(condition, session, pair_id, bin, rolling_cor, rolling_zcor, pair_type),
  rolling_cors_shuf_human %>% dplyr::select(condition, session, pair_id, bin, rolling_cor, rolling_zcor, pair_type)
)

```

```{r}
# ==== Create summary data ====
cor_summary_real_human <- rolling_cors_real_human %>%
  group_by(bin, condition, pair_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(rolling_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_cor = sd(rolling_cor, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(rolling_cor))),
    n = sum(!is.na(rolling_cor)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_summary_shuf_human <- rolling_cors_shuf_human %>%
  group_by(bin, condition, pair_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(rolling_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_cor = sd(rolling_cor, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(rolling_cor))),
    n = sum(!is.na(rolling_cor)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_summary_human <- bind_rows(cor_summary_real_human, cor_summary_shuf_human)

# ==== Plot ====
ggplot(cor_summary_human, aes(x = bin, y = mean_cor, color = pair_type, fill = pair_type, group = pair_type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_cor - sem_cor, ymax = mean_cor + sem_cor), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:n_bin) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("real_pair" = "#E31A1C", "shuffled_pair" = "#1F78B4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("real_pair" = "#E31A1C", "shuffled_pair" = "#1F78B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~condition, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Bin",
    y = "Correlation coefficient for the number of bites (±SEM)",
    color = "Pair type",
    fill = "Pair type"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

# Create data for input to Stan → Estimation
```{r}
# ...（The preprocessing is the same: create all_cor_long）

make_stan_data_miss <- function(dat) {
  dat <- dat %>% filter(bin >= 6)
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(rolling_zcor = ifelse(is.infinite(rolling_zcor), NA, rolling_zcor))
  dat <- dat %>% arrange(pair_id, session, bin, pair_type)
  N_pair <- n_distinct(dat$pair_id)
  N_session <- n_distinct(dat$session)
  N_bin <- 13

  y_vec <- dat$rolling_zcor
  obs_idx <- which(!is.na(y_vec))
  mis_idx <- which(is.na(y_vec))
  N_obs <- length(obs_idx)
  N_mis <- length(mis_idx)

  pair_id_fct <- as.integer(as.factor(dat$pair_id))
  session_id_fct <- as.integer(as.factor(dat$session))
  bin_idx <- dat$bin - 5
  is_real <- as.integer(dat$pair_type == "real_pair")

  list(
    N = nrow(dat),
    N_obs = N_obs,
    N_mis = N_mis,
    N_pair = N_pair,
    N_session = N_session,
    N_bin = N_bin,
    obs_idx = obs_idx,
    mis_idx = mis_idx,
    pair_id = pair_id_fct,
    session_id = session_id_fct,
    bin = bin_idx,
    is_real = is_real,
    y_obs = y_vec[obs_idx]
  )
}

stan_data_list <- list()

for (cond in c("visible_pair", "invisible_pair")) {
  dat_sub <- all_cor_long_human %>%
    filter(condition == cond)   # Include both real and shuffled
  stan_data_list[[cond]] <- make_stan_data_miss(dat_sub)
}

mod <- cmdstan_model("02_ssm_chewing_sync_missing.stan")
output_dir <- "stan_fits"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
set.seed(1234)

fit_list <- list()

make_init_fun <- function(stan_data) {
  y_init <- if (length(stan_data$y_obs) > 0) mean(stan_data$y_obs, na.rm=TRUE) else 0
  list(
    y_mis = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_mis),
    mu0 = y_init,
    mu_pair = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_pair),
    mu_sess_init = matrix(y_init, stan_data$N_pair, stan_data$N_session),
    sigma_pair = 1,
    sigma_sess_init = 1,
    mu_state = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_bin),
    sigma_mu = 1,
    beta0 = 0,
    beta_tan = rep(0, stan_data$N_bin-1),
    sigma_beta = 1,
    sigma_obs = 1
  )
}



for (nm in names(stan_data_list)) {
    #if (nm=="invisible_pair"){
  message(sprintf("Fitting: %s", nm))
  fit <- mod$sample(
    data = stan_data_list[[nm]],
    chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
    iter_sampling = 5000, iter_warmup = 1000,
    seed = 123,
    refresh = 500,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    max_treedepth = 15,
    init = function() make_init_fun(stan_data_list[[nm]])
  )
  fit$save_object(file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("fit_", nm, "_human.rds")))
  fit_list[[nm]] <- fit
  summary_df <- fit$summary(
    variables = NULL,
    posterior::default_summary_measures(),
    posterior::default_convergence_measures(),
    extra_quantiles = ~posterior::quantile2(., probs = c(.025, .975))
  )
  summary_df$condition <- nm
  write.csv(summary_df, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("summary_", nm, "_human.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    #}
}

```


# Plot
```{r}
# ex: Merge summary files
sum_invisible_human <- read_csv("stan_fits/summary_invisible_pair_human.csv")
sum_visible_human   <- read_csv("stan_fits/summary_visible_pair_human.csv")

beta_invisible_human <- sum_invisible_human %>%
  filter(grepl("^beta_state\\[", variable)) %>%
  mutate(bin = as.integer(gsub("beta_state\\[|\\]", "", variable)),
         condition = "invisible_pair")
beta_visible_human <- sum_visible_human %>%
  filter(grepl("^beta_state\\[", variable)) %>%
  mutate(bin = as.integer(gsub("beta_state\\[|\\]", "", variable)),
         condition = "visible_pair")

beta_all_human <- bind_rows(beta_invisible_human, beta_visible_human)

ggplot(beta_all_human, aes(x=bin, y=mean, color=condition, fill=condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q2.5, ymax=q97.5), alpha=0.15, color=NA) +
  geom_line(size=1.3) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  labs(x="Bin", y="Estimated beta_state (mean & 95% CI)",
       color="Condition", fill="Condition") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max(beta_all$bin)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("visible_pair"="#D55E00", "invisible_pair"="#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("visible_pair"="#D55E00", "invisible_pair"="#0072B2")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```
